about: Where the native hook lane intentionally differs from the Node oracle because of the Node shim, not because of a unit. Under the shim (hooks/lib-dispatch.mjs) the native binary's parent is the shim process, so a unit that compares or records the parent pid sees the shim, where Node sees the Claude process. Production hooks.json executes the binary directly (0114 Z), so ParentPid is the Claude process there; the shim is a test-only seam. Proven natively by Ah.Cli.Tests DirectExecParentPidTests.
ruling: orchestrator note 20261011-200656-1ccu (2): register the ppid-dependent rows here, and one native-only row proves ParentPid is the parent under a direct exec.
appliesTo: hook lane, --impl native, through the Node shim
dependsOn: an up record's pid compared with the ending process's parent (sessionend-roster foreignEnd)
a team's orchestrator pid matched against the parent pid when the event carries no session id (ownedTeams: sessionend-roster, sessionstart, activity, stopfailure-recovery)
the pid recorded on a roster, session-pid or registration row (normalized as <PID> in the recorded rows, so equal under the shim)
